Hi Dana — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and a few concrete next steps so we can get a short product intro (30m) scheduled with the right stakeholders: 

Recap (1-line): You’re evaluating embedding retrieval and low-latency generation for a document search + assistant use case (customer support workflows), with an initial pilot focused on the Legal/Support teams and an eventual org-wide rollout.

Proposed 30-min walkthrough goals:
- Live product tour of inference latency, multi-model routing, and cost controls (15m)
- Technical Q&A focused on integrations and data flow (10m)
- Outline next steps & mutual action plan (5m)

I’ve carved out three windows below — please pick the one that best aligns with your team and tell us who should join (we’ll invite a technical lead + PM by default):
- Wed Sep 22 — 09:30–10:00 PT / 12:30–13:00 ET
- Wed Sep 22 — 13:00–13:30 PT / 16:00–16:30 ET
- Thu Sep 23 — 11:00–11:30 PT / 14:00–14:30 ET

If those don’t work, share two 30-min slots that do and we’ll adjust. Also, can you confirm whether Carlos Mendez (security/compliance) should be looped in? If so, we’ll include a short security checklist in the invite.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf (product snapshot), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (editable MAP).

Calendly quick link if you prefer: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

Thanks — I’ll stand by and lock once you confirm.

Best,
